networkAccess.reasoning: Fetches a published design-parity catalog manifest (catalog.json), its DTCG token file, and the sticker-sheet PNGs from a design-artifacts/<system> branch on GitHub, and — for the override editor / structured-screen slot flow — previews, renders, and `/render/<id>.slots` from a `compose-preview serve` host (`preview.coo.ee`, the public demo). Add your own serve host here (or `http://localhost:<port>` for a local daemon) to point the editor at it.
